points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable CMake build passes in network-disabled container with CFD_EXTERNALS_ROOT and JSON_ROOT configured; no complete documented build procedure was identified.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:108–110 parses case and output only, ignores --restart and report-level; :195–198 writes only two-line restart placeholders. Missing-file invocation exits nonzero with clear diagnostic.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: CMake builds separate mesh, solver, io and main files, but core physics/time stepping is concentrated in solver.cpp and restart logic is not implemented.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: CMake builds submitted C++ with MPI/CGNS/METIS; no direct internal external-solver wrapper found. Per trust policy no external similarity or authorship investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case parser and CGNS path are configuration driven; actual meshes and case inputs were used. General independent arbitrary-case tests were not run.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: mesh.cpp:484 METIS; solver.cpp:131–172 neighbor halo exchange and :616–620,689 global reductions; submitted np2 and np8 NACA/Re20 runs agree in Cd. Global mesh is broadcast temporarily during setup then destroyed on return, not retained for iteration.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: First-order steady fallback and frozen transient gradients stabilize the supplied cases, but restart output lacks state and unrecognized CLI options are ignored; no independent stress test.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Eight final directories/report pass structural validator and np2/np8 runs are submitted; no reliable restart test, clean unit-test suite or independent order validation was established.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Build succeeds with configured dependency roots, but no complete build instructions were found and required restart writer is a two-line stub. Generated result paths were curated from the tip while preserved in history.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex governing equations and solver.cpp residual/flux source implement compressible conservation; spatial scheme and output limitations are separately noted.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:48 and :270–282 read zones and TRI/QUAD sections, builds geometry and graph; general MIXED elements and multi-zone cases were not independently validated.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:455 onward assembles conservative face residuals; global norm reductions :616–620. All steady histories reach specified reductions, but formal order is not demonstrated.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: solver.cpp:254 onward implements Rusanov; no Roe or higher-resolution flux is required, but large numerical drag indicates substantial limitations in supplied steady results.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp boundary_ghost_state and io.cpp:72–99 implement boundary states; no-slip output explicitly gives wall values. General boundary variants were not independently tested.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:768–775 zeros gradients and limiters on every steady iteration; second-order reconstruction/limiter is used only in transient. report.tex:91–93 and :561–564 disclose this; steady metadata nevertheless claims spatial_order_claimed=2.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: solver.cpp:230–295 implements Barth–Jespersen and reconstruction; it is explicitly disabled in all steady runs and computed once per transient physical step. Report discloses this.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:399–452 computes viscous gradients and stress, but :645–689 integrates full stress vector without tangential projection; report calls this friction drag. Large reported laminar and Re20 drag limit credibility.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:500–607 implements scalar spectral-radius LU-SGS with local pseudo time; steady runs reach reported residual targets. Full discretization order and restart are separate limitations.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:840–898 implements BDF1/BDF2 full transient residual and inner iteration, with gradients frozen per physical step; metadata gives dt=0.01, t=300 and zero target misses. Residual CSV dt field remains zero and no unsteady rerun was performed.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and neighbor exchanges as above; np2/np8 original histories match closely for NACA and cylinder. Global mesh temporarily exists on all ranks during preprocessing, then local mesh is returned; no np1 full run verified.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Validator accepts structural paths, but all eight restart_final.dat files contain only case and step, not restart state; main.cpp:108–110 does not implement --restart. Residual CSV dt is zero. Final packages are not complete output-contract deliverables.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit official validator exits 0 on all eight cases and report; it misses the semantically empty restart files and zero dt, so this establishes structure only.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: All eight physical histories and fields are present, but required restart files are placeholders and report omits several force plots, including Re200; submission is rejected under TASK.md:226 and examiner README:20.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Report states Cd=0.445 for M0.15 laminar and 4.504 for Re20, far above the same-mesh opus-04 results 0.0541 and 2.021; first-order steady scheme and high-drag force tails are material accuracy limitations.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Twelve-page PDF contains residual and field plots but only selected steady force histories; no committed Re200 force history is referenced, so late lift/drag periodicity is not visually demonstrated.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report explicitly admits first-order steady scheme but incorrectly describes Re20 Cd=4.5 as consistent with 4–4.5 reference and omits force plots for several cases; its completed status and restart omission are not clearly disclosed.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Report summary values match output CSV; figure mappings are available, but full plot-to-field fidelity was not verified and required restart state is absent from all final packages.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean immutable build 3.5/4 with configured JSON_ROOT but no complete documented build command; required CLI 0.5/2 because --restart/report-level are ignored; output completeness 0.5/2 because restart_final.dat contains only case and step and residual dt is zero, despite validator pass; bad-input handling 1/2 because missing file was tested but other cases unverified.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS unstructured read 3.5/4, cell/face geometry 1.5/2, mixed and multi-zone 0.5/2 (TRI/QUAD sections supported; general MIXED and multizone not independently verified), graph adjacency 2/2: mesh.cpp:48,270–282,484 and setup.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservation 4/5, Rusanov flux 3/4, farfield/slip 2.5/3, no-slip 3/3: solver.cpp:455 onward and boundary_ghost_state; supplied outputs support functionality but no independent formal flux/boundary tests were run.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Reconstruction 1/4 and limiter 1/3: solver.cpp:768–775 explicitly zeros gradients/limiters for all seven steady cases; transient implements frozen-gradient limited reconstruction. Positivity 1/2 via state floors, diagnostic/disclosure 1/1: report.tex:91–93,561–564 admits first-order steady method. Steady metadata spatial_order_claimed=2 is inconsistent.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Gradient 2/3, Newtonian/Fourier 2/3, no-slip wall 2/2; tangential force split 0/2: solver.cpp:645–689 integrates the full stress traction as viscous drag, while report labels it friction. High laminar drag remains a substantial numerical limitation.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Steady implicit 3.5/4 and LU-SGS 3/4: solver.cpp:500–607, residual reductions in submitted histories. BDF1/BDF2 physical stepping 3.5/4: :840–898, frozen spatial gradients per physical step. Inner controls/logs 2/3: metadata claims target and 0 misses, but residual CSV dt remains zero and no unsteady rerun was performed.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS 2/2, neighbor exchange 3/3, global reductions 2/2, output 1/1, rank comparisons 0.5/2: np2/np8 original NACA and cylinder histories agree, but no np1 full comparison identified. Full global mesh is broadcast during preprocessing and freed before local solver iteration.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: NACA inviscid 0.75/2: first-order high low-Mach drag and material tail drift; NACA laminar 0.25/2: large drag and M2 tail drift; Re20 0.25/2: Cd=4.504 conflicts with same-mesh opus-04 Cd≈2.021 and report calls 4–4.5 reference; Re200 0.75/2: t=300, numeric St≈0.19 and field/wake exist but no force-history figure; fields 1/1, rank comparisons 1/1. Independent case scores remain separate.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Equations/method 0.75/1; histories 0.25/1 (several cases lack force plots); computed fields 0.75/1; analysis 0.25/1 (first-order steady disclosed, but Re20 Cd=4.504 is presented as a 4–4.5 reference without adequate support); traceability 0.5/1 (numeric values and manifest available, but no usable restart and full pixel-to-array checks unverified).

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Generic physics interface 1/2, boundary extension 0.5/1, 3-D generalization 0.5/1, source organization 1/1; solver is explicitly 2-D and has limited extension hooks.

flags.flag: Mandatory rejection: placeholder required restart files in completed result packages
flags.evidence: All eight canonical solver/output/<case>/restart_final.dat files are exactly two lines, RESTART <case> and STEP <n>, containing no solution state (41–47 bytes). Immutable solver/src/main.cpp:195–198 writes this placeholder, while :108–110 parses only --case/--output and has no restart reader. Despite validator pass and metadata completed=true, the final packages include intentionally partial required result files. TASK.md:226 prohibits placeholder or deliberately partial result files as completed cases; examiner README_EXAMINER.md:20 directs rejection of final submissions containing such files. This mandatory submission rejection is separate from numbered DQ trigger 2: no claim is made that force or residual histories were generated without solving.

session_selection.rationale: Sole workspace-local Claude root; benchmark prompt, full implementation, 22 subagents and terminal end_turn response at source line 3427.

limitations: Actual force/residual runs reached recorded residual reductions; placeholder restart evidence does not imply those histories are synthetic.
All seven steady cases use first-order reconstruction per report and source, while steady metadata spatial_order_claimed=2 is inconsistent.
Independent full figure pixel-to-field verification and general CGNS variants were not performed. No unsteady or Re200 rerun.
